items.title: Louis Barbarin Interview, 1960-06-22
items.q: I've taken my drum lesson from Cottrell. Lewis Cottrell.

ctx.x: Well, I learned him some drums. Yeah, I did. Can you tell us any more about when you started? Did your brother help you, Paul? Had he been playing long before that that you can remember? Well, Paul was playing long before I started. I knew he was older, of course. Yeah, he was playing long. Playing around with different bands around the office. Did he help you any? Did he show you how to hold the sticks or anything? Well, he did. Give me ideas. Paul, give me ideas. Did your father ever teach you anything about…
I've taken my drum lesson from Cottrell. Lewis Cottrell.
Did you tell us more about him?
